name: bridgelogic
description: ESP8266-side decision logic for THIS box that used to live in the composition root: the online-then-roster scan flow, the auth window, walk-up and pay-for request shaping, the offline single-code scan, relight, the !ON retry and !STATE reconciliation. The device-agnostic half (heartbeat, event upload, roster parsing, circuit breaker) is `devlink` in ../../shared/lib. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for Xtensa and host.
